name: AIDC pair-side accumulated burn
summary: AIDC's transfer accounting could burn an accumulated sell-side amount from its own AIDC/WBNB pair, breaking reserve accounting and depleting the pair's WBNB reserve.

loss.notes: Gross loss is the exact net WBNB depletion of AIDC/WBNB pair 0x2725033282b3bd4be8873b7f0f622c18e3b7cbd8 in the single successful incident receipt. The pair receives 100.000034165547162792 WBNB and sends 321.225837525258000289 WBNB, for 221.225803359710837497 WBNB net depletion. Archive balances fall from 221.225824586427689773 WBNB immediately before the incident block to 0.000021226716852276 WBNB after it, reproducing the same difference. The sender's three bounded pre-incident transactions 0x36d7b9d2...7228, 0x75f6e0ba...ab96, and 0x555b8f07...7423 have no AIDC or WBNB transfer to or from the pair and are excluded. The incident credits 220.125803359710837497 WBNB to the attacker; financing fees and downstream routing effects do not reduce gross pair depletion. The closest preceding DefiLlama BNB observation is $550.4782257918903 at 1782675299, 54 seconds before the incident.

ageReset.description: AIDC is directly deployed. Its 11,521-byte runtime is absent one block before creation and has code hash 0xb7b142085403fc1f337b31b82e9d0a7146c3c08b68aa01aa55974f2a6f451773 at deployment and immediately before the incident; both EIP-1967 code-selection slots are zero. The pair-side accumulated burn is in the deployed transfer path and does not depend on a later configuration change.

sources.note: Reviewed the successful incident receipt and call trace, verified deployed source, commit-pinned technical reproduction, published analysis, direct creation receipt, archive runtime code, EIP-1967 slots, pair identity and balances, the sender's bounded precursor receipts, and the preceding BNB price observation. The anchor is successful at block 106926104 index 29, timestamp 1782675353, and its trace reaches direct AIDC token 0x5021d71859f81b4c905b573591db8f9cc4a0c6fe. Pair 0x2725033282b3bd4be8873b7f0f622c18e3b7cbd8 reports token0 AIDC and token1 WBNB before the incident. The verified source and transaction logs establish that deployed transfer accounting burns an accumulated sell-side amount from the pair and breaks its reserve accounting. In the incident receipt, the pair receives 100.000034165547162792 WBNB and sends 321.225837525258000289 WBNB, exactly 221.225803359710837497 WBNB of gross net depletion. Its archive WBNB balance moves from 221.225824586427689773 before block 106926104 to 0.000021226716852276 after the block, the same difference. The sender's three preceding transactions in the bounded window, 0x36d7b9d2...7228, 0x75f6e0ba...ab96, and 0x555b8f07...7423, each have zero AIDC and zero WBNB flow to or from the pair. AIDC was directly created by 0x0ca5c15d3a173065dbecfcfda0963ce8acf70668 in 0x5843cebd...7ac9 at block 106730872 index 43, timestamp 1782587465. Code is absent one block earlier, and the 11,521-byte runtime hashes to 0xb7b142085403fc1f337b31b82e9d0a7146c3c08b68aa01aa55974f2a6f451773 at creation and immediately before the incident. Both EIP-1967 slots are zero. Deployment is therefore the latest age reset, 1782675353 - 1782587465 = 87,888 seconds. The closest preceding DefiLlama point is BNB $550.4782257918903 at 1782675299, making gross depletion worth $121,779.98773283923 and replacing the seed's rounded $121,000 estimate.

notes: Replaces the seed's rounded loss with exact gross WBNB pair depletion valued at the closest preceding BNB price.
